# PR Merge Run Trace

Records where the time of one `/ensemble-pr-merge` run went, as spans in
`.ensemble/state/toolchain/trace-<runId>.jsonl`, and summarises it in the final
report. Tracing is **observational only**: never halt, retry, reorder, delay or
change a merge decision because of a trace verb's output, exit status or
`trace: unavailable (...)` stderr line, and never gate on a trace result. An
unusable trace is reported as `trace_summary` unavailable, never as a failure of
the merge.

`TOOLCHAIN_CLI` is the path the command already resolved through
`tool-path-resolution`.

## RUN_ID first

1. Before any toolchain call, generate it yourself:
   `RUN_ID=$(node -e 'console.log(require("crypto").randomUUID())')`.
2. Open `preflight`, then run the command's preflight exactly as written and
   append `--run-id "$RUN_ID"` to it.
3. Compare `PREFLIGHT_RESULT.runId` with `RUN_ID`. If it differs, adopt
   `PREFLIGHT_RESULT.runId` as `RUN_ID` (the ledger keys on it). Every later
   toolchain-cli call, trace verbs included, passes `--run-id "$RUN_ID"`.
4. On a preflight HALT, close `preflight` with status `error` first.

## Open and close

- Open: `SPAN_<NAME>=$(node "$TOOLCHAIN_CLI" trace start --run-id "$RUN_ID" --name <name> [--kind phase|io|agent|gate|human-wait] [--parent "$SPAN_<PARENT>"] [--attr k=v ...])`.
  It prints a span id even when tracing is unavailable; keep each id in its own
  named variable.
- Close: `node "$TOOLCHAIN_CLI" trace end --run-id "$RUN_ID" --span-id "$SPAN_<NAME>" [--status ok|error|skipped] [--attr k=v ...]`.
- Ignore output, exit status and stderr of both verbs.
- Open a span BEFORE its action and close it AFTER, including on failure, skip
  and HALT paths. On any HALT, and before the final report, close every span
  still open (status `error` on HALT paths).

## Span table (keyed by the command's step titles)

Top-level spans have no `--parent` and run sequentially; every other span
passes `--parent`.

| Step title | Span (kind) | Parent | Open / close, attrs |
|---|---|---|---|
| Toolchain Preflight | `preflight` (phase) | none | Around the preflight call; `error` on `ok:false`. |
| Resolve Target PR | `pr-discovery` (io) | none | Around the whole step; close with `--attr pr=<PR_NUMBER>`, `error` on HALT. |
| Baseline Findings Manifest | `round` (phase) | none | Open with `--attr round=<ROUND_NUMBER>` (from 1) as `SPAN_ROUND`; closed at the end of Re-Verify (below). If the manifest decides to skip to merge, close `round` with status `skipped --attr findings=0`. |
| Baseline Findings Manifest | `manifest` (phase) | `SPAN_ROUND` | `--attr round=<ROUND_NUMBER>`; wraps the manifest reads and decision; close with `--attr findings=<count>`, `error` on HALT. |
| Route Every Finding / Build Payloads | none | | Not traced. |
| Concurrent Dispatch and Barrier | `remediation` (phase) | `SPAN_ROUND` | Open before dispatching anything; close with `--attr dispatched=<count>` after the barrier. |
| Concurrent Dispatch and Barrier | `subagent` (agent), one per finding | `SPAN_REMEDIATION` | Open immediately before launching that finding's Task, so it starts at dispatch: `--attr finding_id=<id> --attr finding_kind=<check\|review_thread> --attr agent=<ROUTE_AGENT>`. Close as that Task settles: `--status ok\|error --attr outcome=<fixed\|escalated\|failed\|hung> --attr pushed=yes\|no`. |
| Concurrent Dispatch and Barrier | `barrier-wait` (phase) | `SPAN_REMEDIATION` | Open after the last launch; close when the last subagent has settled, then close `remediation`. |
| Re-Verify Against Live State | `verify-recheck` (phase) | `SPAN_ROUND` | `--attr round=<ROUND_NUMBER>`; wraps the rebuild and its manifest reads (below); close once findings are marked resolved/still-open. Then close `round` with `--attr findings_open=<count>`. When another round follows, open `round` N+1 and its `remediation`; it has no `manifest` of its own because the previous `verify-recheck` is its manifest. |
| Review Merge Gate | `review-gate` (gate) | none | Open before the head re-read. Children (`--parent "$SPAN_REVIEW_GATE"`): the head read, the pr-review-cycle skill call, and every gate or review read performed by this gate or by the Merge step's pre-merge re-checks. It stays open until the Merge step's pre-merge reviews re-read finishes; then close it (`--status ok` when `mergeable:true`, else `error --attr mergeable=false`). Also close it on any path that aborts to another verification round. |
| Merge (pre-merge sweep) | `sweep.pre-merge` (io) | none | Around the pre-merge sweep. |
| Merge (confirm-status) | `confirm-status` (io) | none | Around the confirm-status check and any user prompt it triggers (see human waits); close once the confirmation is settled. |
| Merge (merge call) | `merge` (io) | none | Around the merge call; close `--status ok\|error --attr method=<METHOD or default>`. |
| Merge (post-merge sweep) | `sweep.post-merge` (io) | none | Around the post-merge sweep. |
| Merge (branch delete) | `branch-delete` (io) | none | Around the branch deletion. |
| Merge (PR comment) | `pr-comment` (io) | none | Around the PR comment. |
| Final Report | none | | See Trace summary. |

Each of these is closed even when its action fails or HALTs; a stop-before-merge
exit (such as `--dry-run`) closes whatever is open.

## Manifest recipe

Applies to the reads in the `manifest` and `verify-recheck` spans (children
of that span):

- `local-ci-gate` (gate): around the local-ci-gate skill run. Close with
  `--attr cache=hit|miss` (`hit` = the skill reused a verdict already bound to
  this head SHA), `--attr head_sha=<sha>` and `--attr verdict=pass|fail|stale|none`.
- `host.change-request-reviews` (io): around that read.
- `host.change-request-threads` (io): around a separate threads call when one is
  made; threads taken from the reviews response need no span.

## Human waits

Wrap every prompt put to the user (each ask) in a span named
`human-wait.<what>` (for example `human-wait.merge-confirm`), kind `human-wait`,
parented under the span of the step that asks (for the merge confirmation, a
child of `confirm-status`). Close it as soon as the answer arrives.

## Trace summary

Before printing the final report: close every span still open, then run
`node "$TOOLCHAIN_CLI" trace summarize --run-id "$RUN_ID" --brief` and parse its
stdout as `TRACE_SUMMARY`. If the call fails, prints nothing parseable, or
prints `{"trace":"unavailable",...}`, use
`{"trace":"unavailable","reason":"<reason>"}` instead. Embed it verbatim as the
report's `trace_summary` key (path, wall_ms, per-phase ms, unaccounted_ms,
human_wait_ms, machine_ms, unfinished, or the unavailable object). It never
changes the other report keys or any outcome.
